setup.title: This kiosk isn't set up yet
setup.body: Add a board to this kiosk from your gym's manage page and the wall shows up here.

retry.title: Can't reach Boardsesh right now
retry.body: Hang tight — this screen reconnects on its own. The wall comes back the moment we do.

leaderboard.emptyTitle: No one's on the board yet
leaderboard.emptyBody: Light a climb and send it — the leaderboard starts with you.
leaderboard.unavailableTitle: Leaderboard's out of reach right now
leaderboard.unavailableBody: We'll keep trying — the rankings come back on their own.

metadata.boardDescription: See what's lit on {{boardName}} right now. Powered by Boardsesh.
metadata.boardFallbackDescription: Live climbing board widget. Powered by Boardsesh.
metadata.leaderboardDescription: Who's sending at {{gymName}}. Powered by Boardsesh.
metadata.leaderboardFallbackDescription: Gym leaderboard widget. Powered by Boardsesh.

leaderboard.errorBody: Couldn't load the latest sends. It'll retry on its own.

embed.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the code and copy it manually.
embed.periodNote: The period parameter accepts day, week, or month.
embed.docsHint: Paste into any HTML page — it stays live.
embed.publicOnlyBoard: Only public boards can be embedded.
embed.publicOnlyGym: Only public gyms can embed the leaderboard.

gymPage.metaDescription: See the boards and live wall at {{gymName}} on Boardsesh.

install.heading: Get the app for this wall
install.body: Light up the boards at {{gymName}} from your phone and log every send.

gymPage.claimBody: Claim it to run the boards, the branding, and what shows up on the wall.
gymPage.claimPendingBody: We're checking that you run this gym. We'll email you either way, usually within a few days.
gymPage.claimPendingDomainBody: We sent a link to your work email. Click it and the gym is yours.
gymPage.claimAuthBody: Log in and we'll drop you straight back here to claim it.

linkBoards.title: Link your boards
linkBoards.body: Climbers can't see any walls here yet.

addHours.title: Add your opening hours
addHours.body: Climbers checking if they can get a session in tonight can't tell.

addDescription.title: Say what climbing here is like
addDescription.body: A couple of lines on the walls, the setting, and the vibe.

putOnTv.title: Put this wall on a TV
putOnTv.body: Turn a screen in your gym into a live board display.

addBranding.title: Add your branding
addBranding.body: Add your logo and colors so your page looks like you.

poster.metaDescription: A print-ready code climbers can scan at the wall.
poster.heading: Scan the code, light up the wall
poster.pitch: Get Boardsesh, pick a climb, and the holds light up on the board in front of you. Log every send while you're at it.
poster.compatibility: Works with Kilter, Tension and MoonBoard.
poster.independence: Boardsesh is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Aurora Climbing, Moon Climbing, or any board manufacturer.

welcome.title: Get your wall live
welcome.allDoneBody: Your gym's ready to roll. Close this whenever.

kiosk.body: Build a kiosk for your wall display

members.title: Invite your crew

manage.title: Manage {{gymName}}
manage.accessDenied: You don't have permission to manage this gym.

insights.subtitle: How your boards did this week compared with last.
insights.byDayAria: Sends per day of the week
insights.noTopClimbs: No sends logged yet this week.

empty.title: No sends this week
empty.body: Time to reset the wall? As soon as climbers log a send here, you'll see who showed up and what they're projecting.

navGuard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
navGuard.body: You have edits on this tab that aren't saved yet. Leaving discards them.

slugGuard.title: Give this gym a web address
slugGuard.body: Your kiosk and public gym page need a short URL slug before anyone can open them.
slugGuard.label: URL slug
slugGuard.errorInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

kiosks.emptyTitle: Point a screen at your wall
kiosks.emptyBody: A kiosk shows what's lit on your boards, live, in any TV browser. Create one, assign your boards, and open its URL on the screen.
kiosks.heading: Kiosks
kiosks.description: TV screens showing your walls live. Each kiosk gets its own URL.
kiosks.capReached: A gym can have up to {{max}} kiosks.
kiosks.needSlugHint: Set your gym's URL slug above — kiosk URLs need it before a TV can open them.
kiosks.openTvNeedsSlug: Set your gym's URL slug first (see the banner above).
kiosks.deleteBody: “{{name}}” goes dark: any TV showing it lands on a not-found screen. This can't be undone.
kiosks.deleteBodyDefault: “{{name}}” is your default kiosk: a TV on the short /kiosk URL switches to your next-oldest kiosk, and TVs on this kiosk's own URL land on a not-found screen. This can't be undone.

reinstall.title: Get this screen back up
reinstall.body: Open this URL in the TV's browser to bring “{{name}}” back, or scan it with a phone to send it over.
reinstall.scanHint: Scan to open on a phone
reinstall.noUrl: Set your gym's URL slug first — then this kiosk gets a link you can put on any screen.

boards.heading: Boards at this gym
boards.description: Link the boards you own so they show up on your gym page and kiosks.
boards.empty: No boards linked yet. Add one to get started.
boards.onlyOwnerCanUnlink: Only the board's owner can unlink it
boards.readOnlyHint: Only the gym owner or an admin can link boards.
boards.unlinkBody: "{{name}}" stops showing on this gym's page and kiosks. You can re-link it anytime.

addDialog.title: Add one of your boards
addDialog.body: Pick a board you own to link to this gym.
addDialog.empty: You don't have any boards left to link.

strays.heading: Boards that might be yours
strays.description: These sit at your gym or drifted off a merged listing. Add the ones that belong here.
strays.lastBoardBody: "{{name}}" has no other boards. Add this one and that listing folds into your gym — old links still land here, and it stops turning up in search as an empty duplicate.
strays.empty: Nothing loose right now. Every board near your gym is already on your listing.

createDialog.title: New kiosk
createDialog.body: Name it after where the screen hangs — “Front desk TV”, “Kilter corner”.
createDialog.created: Kiosk created — its URL ends in /{{slug}}.

editor.needSlug: Set the gym slug to get this kiosk's URL
editor.boardsLoadError: Couldn't load this gym's boards. Reload the page to try again.
editor.slotUnknownBoard: This board is no longer at this gym — remove it.
editor.addBoardNoneLeft: Every gym board is already on this kiosk.
editor.addBoardFullHelper: A kiosk shows up to {{max}} boards.
editor.presetNoneHelper: Add a board and the TV layout appears here.
editor.quadRailHint: Four boards plus the leaderboard is a tight fit — each board gets about 740×420 pixels on a 1080p TV. Check the preview still reads from across the gym.
editor.railDisabledTooltip: Assign at least one board first — the leaderboard ranks sends on this kiosk's boards.
editor.previewHint: This is the real kiosk render — live sends show up as they happen, and unsaved changes preview immediately.
editor.previewMissingBoard: This board isn't at this gym anymore
editor.slotDuplicateError: This board is already on another slot.
editor.scopeInvalidError: Pick one of the kiosk's boards.
editor.installQrSwitch: Show the app-install QR on each board
editor.installQrHelper: Each board shows a code climbers scan to get Boardsesh and log their sends on that wall.
editor.discardBody: Your layout edits aren't saved yet.

profile.heading: Gym profile
profile.description: Your gym's name, address, and what climbers see on the public page.

photo.heading: Gym photo
photo.description: One shot of your wall or board area. It leads your public page and rides along when someone shares the link.
photo.formatsHint: JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to {{maxMb}}MB. Resized to {{maxDimension}}px. Use a real photo of your wall or board area, not an AI-generated one.
photo.unsupportedType: Use a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.
photo.tooLarge: That file is over {{maxMb}}MB. Pick a smaller image.
photo.uploadTooLarge: That photo is still over {{maxMb}}MB after resizing. Pick a different one.

comments.intro: Reply to your gym's comment thread without leaving the console.
comments.heading: What your crew's saying

logo.heading: Gym logo
logo.description: Shows on your kiosk header and embeds. Transparent PNGs look best on the dark TV screen.
logo.tooLarge: That file is over 10MB. Pick a smaller image.
logo.uploadTooLarge: That file is over 2MB and animated GIFs can't be shrunk here. Pick a smaller one.
logo.unsupportedType: Use a JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image.
logo.formatsHint: JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP. Resized to 512px — transparency stays.

colors.heading: Brand colours
colors.description: Your kiosk stays dark; these colours drive the accent on grade chips and highlights.
colors.contrastWarning: {{colors}}: hard to read on the dark kiosk screen (under 3:1 contrast). The kiosk auto-lightens it until it reads.

preview.heading: Kiosk preview
preview.poweredByNote: The “Powered by Boardsesh” badge shows on every kiosk and embed and can't be removed.

reset.title: Reset branding?
reset.body: Clears your logo and all three colours. Kiosks and embeds go back to the Boardsesh look.
